sentences.text: The Hindu Kush -LRB- -LSB- kʊʃ , _ kuːʃ -RSB- Pashto , Persian and -LSB- -RRB- , also known in Ancient Greek as the Caucasus Indicus or Paropamisadae , is an 800 km mountain range that stretches near the Afghan-Pakistan border , from central Afghanistan to northern Pakistan .	Afghanistan	Afghanistan	Pakistan	Pakistan	Pashto	Pashto	Persian	Persian language	Paropamisadae	Paropamisadae	mountain range	mountain range
It forms the western section of the Hindu Kush Himalayan Region -LRB- HKH -RRB- .
It divides the valley of the Amu Darya -LRB- the ancient Oxus -RRB- to the north from the Indus River valley to the south .	Amu Darya	Amu Darya	Indus River	Indus River

The Hindu Kush range has numerous high snow-capped peaks , with the highest point in the Hindu Kush being Tirich Mir or Terichmir at 7708 m in the Chitral District of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa , Pakistan .	Pakistan	Pakistan	Tirich Mir	Tirich Mir	Chitral District	Chitral District	Khyber Pakhtunkhwa	Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

To the north , near its northeastern end , the Hindu Kush buttresses the Pamir Mountains near the point where the borders of China , Pakistan and Afghanistan meet , after which it runs southwest through Pakistan and into Afghanistan near their border .	Afghanistan	Afghanistan	Pakistan	Pakistan	China	China	Pamir Mountains	Pamir Mountains
The eastern end of the Hindu Kush in the north merges with the Karakoram Range .	Karakoram Range	Karakoram Range
Towards its southern end , it connects with the Spin Ghar Range near the Kabul River .	Spin Ghar Range	Safēd Kōh	Kabul River	Kabul River
The Hindu Kush range were a historically significant center of Buddhism with sites such as the Bamiyan Buddhas .	Buddhism	Buddhism	Bamiyan Buddhas	Buddhas of Bamiyan

The range and communities settled in it hosted ancient monasteries , important trade networks , and travelers between Central Asia and South Asia .	South	South Asia	Central Asia	Central Asia	South Asia	South Asia
Buddhism declined , then vanished in the region with Muslim political expansion and the locals began to practice Islam .	Buddhism	Buddhism	Islam	Islam

The Hindu Kush range has also been the passageway during the invasions of the Indian subcontinent , and continues to be important during modern era warfare in Afghanistan .	Afghanistan	Afghanistan	Indian subcontinent	Indian subcontinent
